theorem lg_target : LawfulFunctor PMF := by
  -- First, show the identity law
  have id_law : ∀ {α} (a : α), PMF.map id (PMF.single a) = PMF.single a :=
    fun α a => congrArg PMF.single (PMF.map_id _ _)

  -- Then, show the composition law
  have comp_law : ∀ {α β γ} (f : β → γ) (g : α → β) (p : PMF α),
    PMF.map (f ∘ g) p = PMF.map f (PMF.map g p) :=
    fun α β γ f g p => congrArg (PMF.map f) (PMF.map_comp _ _ _)

  {
    map_id := id_law,
    map_comp := comp_law
  }
